query: I pressed $mod+r and now the arrow keys resize my window and +/- do something to the gaps. What is this mode and how do I get out, and what other custom modes does this setup have?
expected_behavior: Routes to reference/this-system.md (this machine's custom functionalities)
Identifies $mod+r as this machine's resize binding mode (arrows = fine 10px, Shift+arrow = coarse 50px, +/- adjusts the workspace inner gap) and that Escape/Return returns to default mode
Mentions the sibling custom modes — swap ($mod+Ctrl+w) and scratchpad ($mod+minus / $mod+Shift+minus) — as machine-specific, not vanilla sway
Points to man resize (and man <feature>) as the authoritative per-feature doc
notes: Guards against treating $mod+r as a generic/unknown sway binding. These resize/swap/scratchpad modes are bespoke to this machine and each has its own man page; the skill must route to this-system.md and the man pages rather than guess at vanilla sway resize semantics.
